scope: Bench and tank tests before first launch: kill paths, override, ingress, payload basics.
environment: Workshop bench + 1 m test tank; bench PSU, scope on contactor coil, spray rig.
entry_criteria: All electronics installed, firmware loaded, RC and GCS paired.
exit_criteria: All MustHave bench cases pass; failures raise Issues.

environment: Reservoir test area, chase kayak, shore GCS with RTK base, wind <= Beaufort 2.
entry_criteria: Bench plan passed; insurance and waterway permission in place.
exit_criteria: Speed, endurance sample, failsafe and station keeping demonstrated.

scope: System-level acceptance of the assembled cart: payload, speed, grade, E-stop, hill hold, endurance, ingress, noise.
environment: Test track: level dry concrete + 10 % ramp; rated load 250 kg steel plates; stopwatch, GPS speed gun
entry_criteria: Cart fully assembled, battery >= 90 % SoC, tyre/nut torque checked, firmware/DIP config per drawing.
exit_criteria: All MustHave test cases Passed; failures documented as Issues with ECOs raised.

scope: Bench test of each LH/RH drive module before fitting to the chassis.
environment: Bench with 24 V supply, ammeter, optical tachometer, torque wrench.
entry_criteria: Drive module assembled per PUC-1300/1301, key fitted, nut torqued.

scope: Bench verification of the control/power circuit before vehicle tests.
entry_criteria: Enclosure wired per schematic, harness installed.
exit_criteria: All checks Passed; red-lines fed back to the schematic.

environment: Survey site with staff-gauge reference sections.
entry_criteria: Lake trials passed; echosounder calibrated for water temperature.
exit_criteria: Depth accuracy within specification on reference sections.
